motive.zhHans: 绳子是从屋外拉动的，而由于入口的门也锁着，这间房便被认为是密室。Sakuraba 打 Kikuhito，是为了让他撞上窗户、打碎玻璃，好让证据消失。Mikio 腿上有伤，做不到这一点。实际上根本没有用到任何诡计——因为 Kikuhito 从头到尾都待在房间里。这也就是百叶窗关着的原因，免得外面的人看见他藏在窗帘后面。由于他怕高，又必须处理掉凶器，别无选择，只好把它扔了出去。他始终没有提起这件事，是因为他不敢，想到会给对方造成的冲击。Shigematsu 并不想勒索他。他只是希望他放弃这桩婚事，好让 Kaede 和 Sakuraba 能在一起，不必像他当年那样承受同样的处境。
motive.en: The string is pulled outside and the room, because the door at the entrance was also locked, is assumed to be a locked room. Sakuraba hit Kikuhito so that he would hit the window and break the glass so the evidence would disappear. It is impossible for Mikio to do that because he has a hurt leg. Actually, there were no tricks used, since, in reality, Kikuhito was there in the room all the time. That's why the shutters was closed, so that no one could see from the outside that he were hiding behind the curtains. Since his afraid of heights and he needs to get rid of the murder weapon, he didn't have a choice so he threw it. He never mentioned it because he didn't dare, thinking of the shock it would cause him. Shigematsu didn't want to blackmail him. He only wanted him to renounce the wedding so Kaede and Sakuraba could be together, so that couple wouldn't have to endure the same circumstance as he had long ago.

method.zhHans: 借助一根带环的绳子和一点透明胶带，犯人就能制造出密室杀人。绳子是从屋外拉动的，而由于入口的门也锁着，这间房便被认为是密室。平次告诉大家，Sakuraba 是从阳台逃走的。他利用阳台下到下一层。他还能轻松地爬上树，所以借阳台逃走对他并不困难。平次和柯南故意诈他，声称 Sakuraba 就是凶手，并让 Kikuhito 去把平次和柯南先前发现的那捆凶器取回来。先前解释的那套诡计其实并没有被使用。实际上根本没有用到任何诡计——因为 Kikuhito 从头到尾都待在房间里。他还关掉灯，把尸体从一个房间拖到另一个房间，留下一道血迹。之后，Kikuhito 从窗帘后面出来，装出无辜的样子混进聚到现场的人群里。他把那只猫放进房间，为的是让 Sakuraba 的不在场证明站不住脚。
method.en: With the help of string with a loop and a bit of cellotape, the culprit can create a locked room murder. The string is pulled outside and the room, because the door at the entrance was also locked, is assumed to be a locked room. Heiji told them that Sakuraba ran away using the balcony. He get down to the next floor using it. He can also climb a tree with ease so it would be easy for him to ran away using the balcony. Heiji and Conan fake him out by stating Sakuraba is the criminal, and have Kikuhito recover the bundle of murder discovered by Heiji and Conan eairlier. The trick explained earlier was not really used. Actually, there were no tricks used, since, in reality, Kikuhito was there in the room all the time. He also switched the lights off and dragged the body from one room to another, leaving a bloody trail. After that, Kikuhito came out from behind the curtains and joined the people who had gathered at the scene while pretending to be innocent. He put the cat in the room so as to make Sakuraba's alibi fragile.

evidence.zhHans: 他们指出犯人就是 Sakuraba。Sakuraba 打 Kikuhito，是为了让他撞上窗户、打碎玻璃，好让证据消失。至于证据，平次找到了一件沾满血迹的衬衫，那件衬衫是 Sakuraba 的。不过凶器至今下落不明。
evidence.en: They revealed that the culprit is Sakuraba. Sakuraba hit Kikuhito so that he would hit the window and break the glass so the evidence would disappear. As for evidence, Heiji found a shirt covered in blood to which Sakuraba belongs to. However, the murder weapon is still missing.

resolution.zhHans: 平次和柯南开始推理。他们指出犯人就是 Sakuraba。借助一根带环的绳子和一点透明胶带，犯人就能制造出密室杀人。Sakuraba 打 Kikuhito 时，打碎了尸体后方窗户上的玻璃。那扇窗上还有一个小孔。首先，他把绳环固定在窗锁上，把碎玻璃片装回去，再把绳子从孔里穿出。接着，他带着未上锁的窗户走到阳台，轻轻拉绳，让锁稍微向左滑动，把窗户锁上。然后他加大力气拉，使绳子从胶带上脱落。绳子是从屋外拉动的，而由于入口的门也锁着，这间房便被认为是密室。Sakuraba 打 Kikuhito，是为了让他撞上窗户、打碎玻璃，好让证据消失。平次告诉大家，Sakuraba 是从阳台逃走的。他利用阳台下到下一层。Mikio 腿上有伤，做不到这一点；Kaede 和 Yurie 穿的衣服也不适合这么做；至于 Kikuhito，他极度怕高。只剩一个人，那就是 Sakuraba。他还能轻松地爬上树，所以借阳台逃走对他并不困难。平次随后指出，Sakuraba 和 Kaede 其实是一对秘密恋人。他还揭示，Sakuraba 无法原谅 Shigematsu 安排 Kaede 与 Kikuhito 的婚事，因此杀了他。至于证据，平次找到了一件沾满血迹的衬衫，那件衬衫是 Sakuraba 的。Sakuraba 很快被捕。不过凶器至今下落不明。
resolution.en: Heiji and Conan start their deduction. They revealed that the culprit is Sakuraba. With the help of string with a loop and a bit of cellotape, the culprit can create a locked room murder. When Sakuraba hit Kikuhito, he broke some glass off the window behind the body. The window has also a small hole. First, he fastened the loop to the window's lock, put the broken piece back, and pull the string through it. Then, he went to the balcony with the window unlocked and pulled the string gently so the lock slides to the left slightly and locking the window. Then, he pulled the string harder so the string is undone from the tape. The string is pulled outside and the room, because the door at the entrance was also locked, is assumed to be a locked room. Sakuraba hit Kikuhito so that he would hit the window and break the glass so the evidence would disappear. Heiji told them that Sakuraba ran away using the balcony. He get down to the next floor using it. It is impossible for Mikio to do that because he has a hurt leg. Kaede and Yurie wear unsuitable clothes so it would be impossible for them either. As for Kikuhito, he has a terrible fear of heights. Only one person remains and that is Sakuraba. He can also climb a tree with ease so it would be easy for him to ran away using the balcony. Heiji then points out that Sakuraba and Kaede were secretly lovers. He also reveals that Sakuraba couldn't forgive Shigematsu for arranging the marriage between Kaede and Kikuhito so he killed him. As for evidence, Heiji found a shirt covered in blood to which Sakuraba belongs to. Sakuraba is soon arrested. However, the murder weapon is still missing.
